caption: The drawing depicts a single shoe, viewed from the side, with the toe pointing to the left. The shoe appears to be a simple slip-on style and is rendered in shades of beige and light brown, with some subtle grayish and yellowish undertones to indicate contours and shading. The heel area of the shoe shows darker brown coloration and some textured marks, possibly suggesting wear or damage. The shoe rests on a plain, off-white background with no additional objects present. In the lower right corner, there is a small handwritten inscription in black ink that reads: "FEDERAL ART PROJECT W.P.A. OF VA BY EDNA REK."
title: Woman's Slippers
